about: Port 53 (lab PR 224): a program staged in /tmp (R001 kills its exec, as before) whose flows go to a configured resolver's DNS port (exempt: nothing); to port 53 of a server that is no configured resolver (NN-L-CHAIN-002's kill there is new in lab PR 224: held, action Log); to port 53 of a blocklisted server (the held alert does not stand in for NN-L-NET-001's kill, which predates the hold); to port 443 (NN-L-CHAIN-002's kill, as before).

decision.name: Exec from /tmp/
decision.reasoning: Process executed from /tmp/ — common malware staging location

decision.name: /tmp exec followed by network egress
decision.reasoning: Process executed from a staging directory (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm) then opened an outbound flow (other than a lookup at a configured resolver) within the correlation window — dropper C2 (T1059 → T1571); kill the process tree + posture → COMBAT [held back: the kill for a flow to port 53 of a server that is no configured resolver (port 53 was exempt before lab PR 224) — alert only, by default, until the signed per-rule response policy enables it]

decision.name: Outbound to operator-blocked IP/CIDR
decision.reasoning: Outbound flow to operator-blocked IP/CIDR — kill the process tree + posture → COMBAT
